fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Printing a name on back adds $5

The Delgado family reunion has 41 relatives coming this summer. Each picks a navy or heather gray shirt at $20, adds a name on the back for $5 and pays by card. Cousins out of state enter a mailing address. Everyone else collects at the welcome table, and the organizer sees both groups in one table.
